contact.evidence_quote: Bob Ortmyer ... Ortmyer has a rich history in health care leadership with more than 30 years of dedicated service within the WellSpan Health System of York, Pennsylvania. In May 2024, he was asked to also serve as president and chief operating officer at Porter Medical Center.
